CodeListDef.Name: Action Taken with Study Treatment Codelist

Decode.TranslatedText: 0 - Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction
1 - Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out light work
2 - Ambulatory and capable of all selfcare but unable to carry out any work activities
3 - Capable of only limited selfcare; confined to bed or chair >50% of waking hours
4 - Completely disabled; cannot carry on any selfcare

ConditionDef.Name: Post-Discontinuation / Death Chronology Guard

ConditionDef.Name: Eligibility Confirmation Prior to Study Dosing

ConditionDef.Name: Adverse Event Concomitant Medication Reconciliation

ConditionDef.FormalExpression: FORM.AE.AECONTRT != 'Y' or ITEM.ProhibitedTherapies is not None

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: No other therapeutic modality is permitted such as intrathecal therapy or radiotherapy.

ConditionDef.Name: Clinically Significant Lab Abnormality to AE Reconciliation

ConditionDef.Name: Hy's Law Drug-Induced Liver Injury (DILI) Safety Screen
ConditionDef.Description: Potential Hy's Law Case (ALT/AST >= 3x ULN with Total Bilirubin >= 2x ULN): requires immediate medical monitor notification and SAE evaluation within 24 hours.
ConditionDef.FormalExpression: not (ITEM.Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP) >= 3.0 * ULN and ITEM.BilirubinLimit >= 2.0 * ULN)

ConditionDef.Name: Longitudinal Weight Change >= 10% BSA & Dose Recalculation
ConditionDef.Description: Subject body weight changed by > 10% from baseline; verify weight entry and recalculate Body Surface Area (BSA) and dosing.

ConditionDef.Name: QTcF Longitudinal Increase > 60 ms from Baseline (ICH E14)
ConditionDef.Description: QTcF interval increased by > 60 ms from baseline (ICH E14 cardiac safety threshold); requires triplicate ECG confirmation and cardiology evaluation.

MethodDef.Name: Body Surface Area (BSA — DuBois & DuBois Formula)
